mapper.sql: w.code, w.province_code, w.name, w.name_en, w.full_name, w.full_name_en, w.code_name, w.unit_type, w.postal_code, w.area_km2, w.dataset_version, w.is_active, p.name AS province_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wards w JOIN provinces p ON p.code = w.province_code WHERE w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, ) ORDER BY w.area_km2 NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM wards w JOIN provinces p ON p.code = w.province_code WHERE w.code = #{code}
SELECT FROM wards w JOIN provinces p ON p.code = w.province_code WHERE w.code IN #{code} ORDER BY p.code, w.name
SELECT FROM wards w JOIN provinces p ON p.code = w.province_code WHERE w.province_code = #{provinceCode} AND w.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY w.unit_type, w.name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wards WHERE is_active = TRUE

SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', json_agg(json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', w.code, 'properties', json_build_object( 'code', w.code, 'name', w.name, 'fullName', w.full_name, 'unitType', w.unit_type, 'provinceCode', w.province_code), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(w.geom_display, 5)::json) ORDER BY w.code))::text FROM wards w WHERE w.province_code = #{provinceCode} AND w.is_active = TRUE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
